objective: Coordinator's go-ahead (17 November 2026), DISTANCE-DIM-20261117-001's first direction: which three-place knot laws placed on the six-regular weave are disordered (their counts' log a linear ruler at large scale), critical, or frozen; whether each law's information is pairwise; and so for which laws the distance that carries the information also steps outward without skipping on the weave's own meeting pattern.
